races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Selling Handicap

runners.name: Mister Daydream
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner at 1m2f and 1m3f for Charlie Johnston last spring but career has gone wrong since and was picked up for 1,000gns last autumn; again finished last on his latest run but wasn't beaten far and the handicapper's proving quick to relent; this is easier.
runners.comment: Again finished last on his latest run but not beaten far; handicapper quick to relent

runners.name: Cezarro
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who was well backed on turf here last time, when coming away with two subsequent winners; a player on that, having since been picked up from Ross Burdon for 1,800gns, but he's never been quite this far and will need to settle better.
runners.comment: Solid third on turf here latest; never been quite this far and will need to settle better

runners.name: Marinakis
runners.spotlight: Won when cheekpieces were first fitted and again when they were reapplied early in the year, so it's a plus point that they are back on today; not shown much since leaving Ian Williams but soft ground was no good to him last time and he'll be happier back on the AW.
runners.comment: Not shown much since leaving Ian Williams but he'll be happier back on the AW

runners.name: Douglas Dc
runners.spotlight: Only ever won once, over hurdles in 2022; another ordinary effort last time, also for Billy Loughnane, and the return to the AW for the first time in over a year will need to spark him back to life.
runners.comment: Only won once, over hurdles in 2022; ordinary effort last time, also for Billy Loughnane

runners.name: Moonlit Cloud
runners.spotlight: Four wins on turf, mainly in the spring months, and she's 0-12 on the AW; better effort at Windsor in May but never went a yard without the usual cheekpieces (back today) as favourite last time; Polytrack record wouldn't inspire.
runners.comment: Four wins come on turf, mainly in the spring months, and she's 0-12 on the AW; poor latest

runners.name: Heart Sign
runners.spotlight: Inclined to pull hard in early runs and has got into the habit of blowing the start lately; that's what's cost him the past twice and this mark is surely within range under Oisin Murphy (0-3 for the yard) if it falls right now switched to a visor.
runners.comment: This mark is surely within range under Oisin Murphy if it falls right switched to a visor

runners.name: Sapphire Dream
runners.spotlight: Failed to win in Ireland (5f-1m); bit of hope for his new yard at Yarmouth (1m2f) but that was a poor race, the winner aside (runner-up bombed since), and he has stamina to prove upped in trip again.
runners.comment: Bit of hope for his new yard (1m2f) but that was a poor race; stamina to prove up in trip

runners.name: Maryland Star
runners.spotlight: Said to have taken a false step and briefly lost her action last time; she again started a big price, though, and first-time headgear will need to help for a trainer who looks to have stronger claims with Moonlit Cloud.
runners.comment: First-time hood needs to help; trainer looks to have stronger claims with Moonlit Cloud

runners.name: Premier Cru
runners.spotlight: Regressed from a fair Kempton debut and has run poorly in two starts since handicapping; the return to Polytrack and a first-time tongue-tie will need to make a big difference.
runners.comment: The return to Polytrack and first-time tongue-tie will need to make a big difference

runners.name: Lunar Power
runners.spotlight: Veteran who hasn't won since 2023, stays a deal further and is on the downgrade now; patchy for his new yard this year and others make greater appeal back from seven weeks off.
runners.comment: Veteran who hasn't won since 2023, stays a deal further and is on the downgrade now

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.name: Cavalier
runners.spotlight: Colt by Minzaal; beaten 2.75l when sixth of nine on his debut at Newbury last month (6.5f, good to soft; 4-1 joint-favourite); should improve; chance.
runners.comment: Shaped quite well when 2.75l sixth of nine on Newbury debut; should improve; chance

runners.name: Perfect Nation
runners.spotlight: Bought for 100,000euros at a breeze-up; by Sioux Nation; promising 3.5l second in a Windsor maiden last month (6f, good to firm; 6-4 favourite); that form is nothing special but he should improve for the experience; a possible.
runners.comment: 100,000 breeze-up; second in 6f Windsor maiden on debut (6-4 favourite); should improve

runners.name: Son Of A Fish
runners.spotlight: Colt by Territories out of a useful 9.5f winner; likely sort who is worth a market check.
runners.comment: Colt by Territories out of a useful 9.5f winning mare; worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Drum Bay
runners.spotlight: Home-bred by New Bay; half-brother to a 7f AW winner out of a 7f-1m2f winner; interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: Home-bred; half-brother to a 7f AW winner; dam won at 7f-1m2f;  interesting newcomer

runners.name: Mino
runners.spotlight: 65,000gns yearling by Palace Pier; dam a useful 7f/1m winner; could go well on debut.
runners.comment: 65,000gns yearling by Palace Pier; second foal of a useful 7f/1m winner; could go well

runners.name: Peak Tram
runners.spotlight: American-bred by Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile winner Liam's Map; half-brother to four dirt winners and a 2m1f jumps winner; market a guide to what is expected on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to four dirt winners and a jumps winner (2m1f); worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Harbour Prince
runners.spotlight: Colt by Palace Pier; £70,000 yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to four winners at up to 1m (one on the AW); dam 7f winner; worth a market check on debut.
runners.comment: £70,000 yearling by Palace Pier; half-brother to 4 winners; worth a market check on debut

runners.name: There Goes My Hero
runners.spotlight: First foal of an unraced mare by Mastercraftsman; likely to improve for the experience.
runners.comment: First foal of an unraced mare by Mastercraftsman; likely to improve for the experience

runners.name: Goblet
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on both starts so far, last time finishing 14.5l fourth of five in a Newbury novice (7f, good to firm; 100-1); plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts so far, including last time at Newbury (100-1); plenty to prove
runners.owner: J F Dean, Mrs J Scott & Lady Trenchard

runners.name: Carrow Road
runners.spotlight: £40,000 breeze-up buy who was beaten 20l in a 5f maiden at Hamilton on his debut in May (good to firm; 16-1); takes a marked step up in trip; should do better.
runners.comment: £40,000 breeze-up buy; well-beaten 16-1 shot on Hamilton debut (5f); should do better

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.name: Victory Gold
runners.spotlight: Solid Ascot debut from the front in May, when having Romanza and Thunder Home behind, but well beaten at odds-on next time before never involved at Royal Ascot; has something to prove now.
runners.comment: Well beaten at odds-on second time before never involved at Royal Ascot; has it to prove

runners.name: Romanza
runners.spotlight: Decent Ascot debut behind Victory Gold (6f) before running as well as could have been expected in the Listed Chesham Stakes (7f) latest; back to calmer waters today for a trainer whose strike-rate with 2yos is up this season (0-26 with them here).
runners.comment: Decent effort in the Listed Chesham Stakes (7f) latest; back to calmer waters today

runners.name: Apulia Bay
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns foal, 600,000gns yearling who's a half-brother to Group 3-placed 1m4f Tapeta winner Nightime Dancer; stable going well and has made a bright start with 2yos (3-8, including a winning newcomer for the same connections); interesting debutant.
runners.comment: 600,000gns yearling; stable going well and he's an  interesting debutant

runners.name: Cloud Summit
runners.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling who made a pleasing debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) when fluffing the start but coming home nicely in a race in which the leaders didn't come back; will have learned from that and is shortlisted.
runners.comment: Pleasing debut at Newbury (6.5f) when fluffing the start but coming home nicely; player

runners.name: Royal Titan
runners.spotlight: $22,000 yearling, £62,000 breeze-up 2yo who's a half-brother to four winners in the US; the market will be the ultimate guide on debut.
runners.comment: $22,000 yearling, £62,000 breeze-up 2yo who's a half-brother to four winners in the US

runners.name: Il Capo
runners.spotlight: Big prices for two runs on turf, not looking best suited by the drop to 6f last week despite his speedy pedigree; perhaps nurseries will be his time to shine.
runners.comment: Big prices for two runs on turf; perhaps nurseries will be his time to shine

runners.name: Sea Idol
runners.spotlight: Hard to know what to make of his debut second in a small-field Tapeta race in May, with them finishing in a heap; there was promise in it, though, with him coming home nicely at a big price and he's entitled to improve.
runners.comment: Promise on debut, when coming home nicely at a big price; entitled to improve

runners.name: Minzaal Time
runners.spotlight: £135,000 yearling; inclined to pull hard and failed to see it out on recent 6f Windsor debut; trainer has a much better record with 2yos on the AW than turf, including this season, and this one should fare better.
runners.comment: Trainer has a much better record with 2yos on the AW than turf; should fare better

runners.name: Thunder Home
runners.spotlight: May foal who finished behind Victory Gold and Romanza (since improved) when all three made their debuts at Ascot (6f) a couple of months ago; will need a big step forward if he's to take this.
runners.comment: Behind Victory Gold and Romanza when all three made their debuts at Ascot (6f) in May

races.race_name: Syd Renwick 90th Birthday Handicap

runners.name: Worlington
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when tried in cheekpieces/tongue-tie at Ffos Las last week (1m4f, good); same headgear here and a chance back on AW and up in trip.
runners.comment: Off the mark in this combination of headgear last week (1m4f); up in trip; contender

runners.name: La Trinite
runners.spotlight: Ex-Mike Murphy; shaped as though she would stay further when second on stable debut at Brighton last month (1m4f, good to firm); could go well back on AW.
runners.comment: Ex-Mike Murphy; staying-on second over 1m4f last time and could go well on first run at 2m

runners.name: Artavian
runners.spotlight: Fair third at Chepstow last time (1m2f, good to soft); yet to win in nine runs on AW and, although he stays 1m4f, has stamina to prove at this trip.
runners.comment: Fair third on turf last time; 0-9 on AW; stamina to prove on first run at this trip
runners.owner: G E Bassett & P R Chamings

runners.name: Break Point
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler; off the mark on the Flat at Kempton last week (2m) and although penalised 5lb, is a proven stayer and a possible.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler; off the mark on the Flat on AW last week; 5lb penalty; a possible

runners.name: Smith
runners.spotlight: Veteran; seven-time C&D winner, but latest success was back in 2024 and he hasn't been at his best on the Flat this year.
runners.comment: Veteran; seven-time C&D wins but not scored since 2024 and below par on Flat this year

runners.name: Home Secretary
runners.spotlight: Has improved since going handicapping, but was 8l behind Worlington at Ffos Las last week (1m4f, good); needs to benefit from new headgear and this step up to 2m.
runners.comment: Behind Worlington last week so needs to improve for new headgear and this longer trip

runners.name: Femme Fatale
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; bred to stay well and may do better up in trip on AW debut after finishing tailed off over 1m6f on turf (soft) last time.
runners.comment: Bred to stay well; may do better at 2m on AW after poor run over 1m6f on soft last time

runners.name: Master Dancer
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler/chaser but maiden on the Flat; fair third over 1m4f at Kempton two runs back, but tailed off at Bath last time (1m4f, good); others appeal more.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler/chaser; fair AW third two runs back, but tailed off on turf last time

runners.name: October Surprise
runners.spotlight: Modest form over 1m for Jack Channon; needs to improve for marked step up in trip on stable debut.
runners.comment: Ex-Jack Channon; modest form over 1m; needs to be far better up in trip on stable debut

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Michaela's Boy
runners.spotlight: Two wins and a close second to his name in four runs over C&D; tended to be hot and cold in the past, twice winning back-to-back, which bodes well after bouncing back off 4lb lower at Yarmouth last time; goes well for Luke Morris too.
runners.comment: Two wins and a close second to his name in four runs over C&D; decent claims upped 4lb

runners.name: Nogo's Dream
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten (2-2) under Oisin Murphy until finding traffic in the Windsor race he'd won last summer a fortnight ago; unlikely he'd have won there but he's consistent, fine round here and on a winning mark, so is one to consider.
runners.comment: Fine round here and on a winning mark, so is one to consider under Oisin Murphy (2-3)

runners.name: Sandscreendeliverd
runners.spotlight: Poor effort last time will need forgiving but he's always been capable of the odd stinker; better drawn than for two runs here early in the year and it wouldn't be a shock to see him bounce back.
runners.comment: Better drawn than for two runs here early in the year; no surprise to see him bounce back

runners.name: Hoodie Hoo
runners.spotlight: First crack at shy of 6f when well held at Brighton (5.3f) last time; still only has a Tapeta maiden win to his name and has had his moments at the stalls; another furlong would have looked optimal round here.
runners.comment: Had his moments at the stalls; another furlong would have looked optimal round here
runners.owner: Ged Mason, Sir Alex Ferguson, Jim McGoff

runners.name: Lebron Power
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner last year, twice on soft ground, who's proved tough to place this season; better effort last time but will need to better that on her AW debut.
runners.comment: Tough to place this season; better last time but will need to better that on her AW debut

runners.name: Havana Blast
runners.spotlight: Consistent since returning from 18 months off; easy to argue he's happier on the AW than turf, so he's at least entitled to close the gap on Michaela's Boy from Yarmouth on 5lb better terms; the hood comes off today.
runners.comment: Consistent since returned from 18 months off; easy to argue he's happier on the AW; player

runners.name: Law Of Average
runners.spotlight: Has won on the AW but off a much lower mark and all his best efforts have come on turf, including two wins in the spring; looked like the handicapper may have caught up again when third to Michaela's Boy last time and he's drawn wide today.
runners.comment: Best efforts have come on turf; looks like the handicapper may have caught up again

runners.name: Counsel
runners.spotlight: Four wins to his name from seven starts here, two of them over 7f; most victories have come in the winter and he's been quiet since a Tapeta win off this mark, while stall 9 isn't great for one happiest on the sharp end.
runners.comment: Four wins to his name from seven starts here; mix of 5f and stall 9 not ideal

runners.name: Dontspoilasale
runners.spotlight: Dundalk regular who's done most racing over further, usually ridden prominently, and been off for three months; would want to see some market confidence for his new yard.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; off for three months; would want to see some market confidence for his new yard

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Almaty Star
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who's drawn to attack and boasts a solid record over C&D; not much room for manoeuvre off this mark, though, for a yard also responsible for Ziggy's Missile.
runners.comment: Front-runner who's drawn to attack; not much room for manoeuvre off this mark

runners.name: Tan Rapido
runners.spotlight: Chelmsford winner off 5lb higher this time last year; boasts a fair record overall at this trip on the AW and a return to form wouldn't surprise; may well be dropped in and ridden for luck from stall 9.
runners.comment: Fair record overall at this trip on the AW and a return to form wouldn't surprise

runners.name: Solar Edge
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who's resumed better than ever, backing up his Bath win with a Windsor near-miss off 1lb lower (inclined to hang left); might have been better drawn but can't be discounted for a yard that's won with four of its last five runners.
runners.comment: Front-runner who's resumed better than ever; might have been better drawn

runners.name: Mick's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Ten-time C&D winner, mainly from the front, including twice earlier in the year, latterly off this mark; this company a bit warmer than he's used to and there's other pace in here, so he'll need something close to a career-best effort.
runners.comment: Ten-time C&D winner, mainly from the front; needs something close to a career-best effort

runners.name: Temple Of Athena
runners.spotlight: Best over 5f and currently 1-1 on the AW (Tapeta); run in Listed company twice since then and once over 6f, and is best judged on her latest Epsom fourth off the same mark; holds claims on that into a less-competitive handicap.
runners.comment: Best judged on her latest Epsom fourth; claims on that into a less-competitive handicap

runners.name: Dyrholaey
runners.spotlight: Won over 5f early in his career but has raced exclusively over 6f for the past two years, latterly when winning here for Harry Vigors (then claiming 7lb) off 3lb lower in April; goes well fresh but another furlong would have been ideal round here.
runners.comment: Goes well fresh but another furlong would have been ideal round here; strong pace ideal

runners.name: Accrual
runners.spotlight: Lost his way and is now 10lb lower than when narrowly beaten over C&D early in the year; needs a revival but hasn't had conditions to suit on turf lately and ought to fare much better.
runners.comment: Needs a revival but hasn't had conditions to suit on turf and ought to fare much better

runners.name: Ziggy's Missile
runners.spotlight: Come to hand early in previous seasons but hasn't offered much in two runs back this time; now 11lb lower than when winning at Chelmsford last summer, which shows how things have gone since; needs a major revival.
runners.comment: 11lb lower than when winning at Chelmsford last summer, which shows how things have gone

runners.name: Nezeeh
runners.spotlight: Irish wins came on turf and his record on Polytrack at Dundalk wasn't great; poor this spring and goes without the usual blinkers for his new yard; would want to see support before factoring him in.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; poor this spring; would want to see support before factoring him in

races.race_name: Expert Entertainment & Event Solutions Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: West Byfleet
runners.spotlight: Goodwood second two months ago solid enough; below that level last time down to 7f at Ffos Las (dam won over 1m6f for the yard) under Billy Loughnane (rides Rogue Defence today); still one of the likelier winners.
runners.comment: Goodwood second two months ago solid enough; below that level last time though

runners.name: Mythological Star
runners.spotlight: Well held on his AW debut but much better here last time (turf), when having Santiago Boy back in fourth; the extra furlong will suit on both pedigree and that evidence, and he's high on the shortlist under reigning Bahrain champion jockey Ebrahim Nader.
runners.comment: Extra furlong will suit on both pedigree and latest evidence; high on the shortlist

runners.name: Fiefdom
runners.spotlight: Sole AW effort (Tapeta), when hitting traffic, much better than his two turf runs; may well be dropped in again from a wide stall, in which case he'll need the breaks for a yard in decent form of late.
runners.comment: Sole AW effort (Tapeta) much better than two turf runs; one to consider despite stall 12

runners.name: Santiago Boy
runners.spotlight: Taking a while for the penny to drop and will need to settle better than over 7f (turf) here last time (some way off Mythological Star); room for improvement at the start too but he still has a bit of potential.
runners.comment: Some way off Mythological Star latest; still a bit of potential if he can get it together

runners.name: Rogue Defence
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over C&D on debut, in the spring; ran to a similar level under a penalty on turf six weeks ago, but didn't look to see out a stiff 1m2f (stamina was a question on pedigree) that day and will be happier back down in trip.
runners.comment: Won his maiden over C&D on debut, in the spring; will be happier back down from 1m2f

runners.name: Cherringham
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard on her turf debut here (soft) a month ago and again on Tapeta a week ago; those were two weak maidens, latterly against her own sex, but the fitting of a hood and drop in trip ought to help.
runners.comment: The fitting of a hood and drop in trip ought to help but this is a stronger race

runners.name: Seigneur
runners.spotlight: Gelded 28,000gns yearling whose half-brother Waistcoat won four 6f handicaps at an ordinary level; hooded on debut and the market will show what's anticipated.
runners.comment: Gelded 28,000gns yearling; hooded on debut and the market will show what's anticipated
runners.owner: Booth, Silver, Steed And Fittocks Stud

runners.name: Legally Bay
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to four winners, including three on the AW; no surprise were she one for handicaps down the line, so may be best watched unless there's good money around.
runners.comment: Half-sister to four winners; may be best watched unless there's good money around

runners.name: Nothing But Love
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Approval; raced wide on her debut here (turf) a month ago, when a long way off the front trio; likely she'll need more time.
runners.comment: Raced wide on her debut here (turf) a month ago, when a long way off the front trio

runners.name: Ivat Ghia
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held in two 7f starts earlier in the year; pulled hard at Doncaster and is now tried in a hood; likely she'll find things easier once handicapping.
runners.comment: Hood tried after pulling hard latest; likely she'll find things easier once handicapping

runners.name: Lady Of Chivalry
runners.spotlight: Just a fair debut (Tapeta) for Andrew Balding last summer before moving yards this spring; pulled hard from a wide stall on her comeback and will need to settle much better upped in trip; low-grade handicaps probably next.
runners.comment: Will need to settle much better upped in trip; low-grade handicaps probably next

runners.name: Ingemar
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard in two runs on turf last month (1m2f, 1m) and finished well beaten each time; from a decent family but will need to settle down if he's to progress and will likely find things easier once handicapping.
runners.comment: Needs to settle if he's to progress and will likely find things easier once handicapping

races.race_name: Follow @AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap

runners.name: Fallacious Promise
runners.spotlight: Bumped into one at Kempton early in the year and again on Tapeta in May; things went wrong over C&D last time and he deserves a change of luck off the same mark; his claims are obvious.
runners.comment: Bumped into one at Kempton early in the year and again on Tapeta in May; leading claims

runners.name: Athenian Spirit
runners.spotlight: Latest run, back from a break in a turf sprint, is best overlooked; holds claims on a few of his placed efforts last winter but did look to find this trip stretching him in one previous go (C&D).
runners.comment: Claims on a few of his placed efforts last winter but this trip stretches him
runners.owner: Mpr Xxi, S Marris & Rathmoy Racing Vii

runners.name: Henfield
runners.spotlight: Didn't look to see out 1m2f in a 0-50 classified event here last time and is tried in first-time headgear back down in trip; not easily recommended.
runners.comment: Tried in first-time headgear back down in trip; not easily recommended

runners.name: Wild Rosie
runners.spotlight: Hung left last time (may have been down to soft ground); had previously offered more in first-time cheekpieces, without quite seeing out a stiff 1m in better company, and a case could be made for this half-sister to a three-time Kempton winner.
runners.comment: Hung left on soft latest; case could be made for this half-sister to three-time AW winner

runners.name: Laurasia
runners.spotlight: Bit better behind Fallacious Promise over C&D a month ago (always near the front; hung right late on); ran to a similar level when well off the winner on turf last time and needs to find more.
runners.comment: Bit better behind Fallacious Promise over C&D a month ago; holds each-way claims

runners.name: Whazzimo
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to numerous winners, notably Culturati and Valiant; has not achieved much in three sprints but starts handicap life at a basement level, upped in trip on her Polytrack debut, and market confidence would see her enter calculations.
runners.comment: Starts handicap life at basement level; market confidence would see her enter calculations

runners.name: Moravian
runners.spotlight: Longer trip not assured on pedigree but she offered a bit more last time (6f) and this is more realistic now handicapping; worth tracking in the market.
runners.comment: Offered a bit more last time (6f) and this is more realistic now handicapping

runners.name: Ruiz
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off last behind Fallacious Promise over C&D a month ago; didn't see out 1m2f on turf last time but is seemingly exposed as moderate.
runners.comment: Tailed-off last behind Fallacious Promise over C&D a month ago; outsider

runners.name: Action Reaction
runners.spotlight: Had issues at the stalls and is yet to get close to being involved in a finish; the first-time tongue-tie and first-time blinkers will need to make a massive difference.
runners.comment: The first-time tongue-tie and first-time blinkers will need to make a massive difference

runners.name: Ernie McCrew
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress in maidens and ran poorly on his handicap debut over this trip on Friday, when a remote last of seven; hard to fancy on his Polytrack debut.
runners.comment: Ran poorly on his handicap debut over this trip on Friday; hard to fancy

races.race_name: EBF Stallions Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Ten Clarets
runners.spotlight: 35,000euros yearling who shaped with considerable promise before fading into fourth of seven at York (6f, good) last month, form that has recently been well advertised by the runner-up; bred to be better suited by this longer trip; good chance.
runners.comment: Shaped with considerable promise before fading into fourth at York (6f) last month

runners.name: Redline
runners.spotlight: Out of a 1m2f Listed winner and led close home to make winning debut at Carlisle (6f, good) last month; seems sure to be suited by the extra furlong here and has obvious scope for progress; leading contender.
runners.comment: Led close home over 6f on debut and seems sure to be suited by this extra furlong

runners.name: Dreamlighter
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to winners Fanjove (7f AW 2yo; RPR 66), Wise Men Say (5f/7f including 2yo) and an Italian 6f/7.5f winner; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Nidhaal (6f 2yo Listed) and Maslak (prolific 11.6f-1m6f); already gelding and has pretty good standard to reach on debut but represents a respected stable.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to a 6f 2yo Listed winner; represents respected stable

runners.name: Too Many Spirits
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut when very close second at Pontefract (5f, good) in April and was not discredited when well-held second behind useful rival there (6f, good to soft) in May; up in trip again here and has another big role to play.
runners.comment: Went close at Pontefract (5f) in April and chased home useful rival there (6f) in May

runners.name: Sara's Silver Girl
runners.spotlight: 25,000gns yearling; first foal; dam 6f 2yo winner (RPR 95), half-sister to winners Graft (5f 2yo Listed) and Ribenska (7f), out of a well-connected 7f winner; stable runs two other newcomers in this race.
runners.comment: 25,000gns yearling; dam useful 6f 2yo winner; one of three newcomers from stable

runners.name: Thai Paddy
runners.spotlight: 7,500gns yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to three winners including Plegastell (French 1m 2yo including Listed; RPR 100) and a French 10.5f winner; dam placed 1m1f-1m3f in France, half-sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Pleuven; considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Out of a French middle-distance maiden; considered only if lively in the betting

runners.name: The Resdev Rocket
runners.spotlight: £24,000 yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Mearall (6f 2yo; RPR 89) and Love Lies (6f; 78); dam unraced half-sister to a French middle-distance winner; already gelded; stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners.
runners.comment: Half-brother to a useful 6f 2yo winner but stable not known for first-time-out winners

runners.name: Threeoclockflyer
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns yearling; third foal; half-brother to winners Hot Cash (7f 2yo/1m; RPR 93) and Spirit Of Athene (1m AW 2yo; 66); dam 1m2f/1m4f winner (including Group 3; 109), half-sister to winners Hatta Fort (7f 2yo Group 2) and Blue Bayou (7f 2yo Group 3); already gelded; one of three newcomers from the stable.
runners.comment: Out of a middle-distance Group 3 winner; one of three newcomers from the stable

runners.name: Don't Stop Movin
runners.spotlight: Quite stoutly bred colt who kept on for second (no threat to winner) on debut at Redcar (7f, good) in May; probably won't be seen to best effect until moving up in trip but still considered.
runners.comment: Quite stoutly bred colt; kept on for second on debut at Redcar (7f); considered

runners.name: Aurora Valkyrie
runners.spotlight: Left inauspicious debut behind when respectable fifth of ten behind Redline at Carlisle (6f, good) three weeks ago but needs to take another step forward over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Second run was much better than her debut but she needs to progress again

races.race_name: racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap

runners.name: Sweet Kiss
runners.spotlight: Did well last year, winning three times over 1m2f; yet to hit top gear after three starts this season (1m3f-1m4f) but is back on a good mark and won't mind what the weather does; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Yet to hit top gear this season but on a good mark and won't mind what the weather does

runners.name: Tap Dancer
runners.spotlight: Became disappointing for Marcus Tregoning last year and has been safely held on all three starts for Jim Goldie this season but continues to slip down the weights and will be favoured by the forecast rain; can't be written off just yet.
runners.comment: Safely held on all three stable starts but can't be written off just yet

runners.name: Condotti
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 12 runs and not yet proven over this fair but gave good account when third at Hamilton (8.3f, good to soft) last month and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Gave good account when third at Hamilton (8.3f) last month and enters calculations

runners.name: Rumbustious
runners.spotlight: Weakened into fourth of five after making the running at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 0-7; needs to find something extra here.
runners.comment: Weakened into fourth of five at Windsor last time and is now 0-7; needs to find extra

runners.name: Hill O Rue
runners.spotlight: Won twice on ground slower than good last season (1m1f/1m2f) and is still quite lightly raced but looked out of sorts on both appearances this spring and needs recent wind op to have made a difference.
runners.comment: Looked out of sorts on both outings this spring; given wind op since; needs to bounce back
runners.owner: Gordon Bulloch & S Hardcastle D Szepler

runners.name: Naturalia
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three consecutive times in recent weeks, perhaps most notably when losing out only by a head in higher-grade company at Carlisle (1m3f, good to soft) two starts ago; also suited by this C&D; likely contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up three consecutive in recent weeks and an obvious contender again here

runners.name: Parole Officer
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well in AW nursery on stable debut in November but was well beaten twice on turf in the spring (1m/8.3f); moves up in trip with cheekpieces tried here; others have much less to prove.
runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts this spring; up in trip with cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Royal Blaze
runners.spotlight: Needs to rebound from a substandard AW run ten days ago but made the frame on two of three turf starts in the spring (both times over 1m1f) and this longer trip probably suits better; can't be ignored off current mark.
runners.comment: Below form on AW last week but twice in the frame on turf this spring; can't rule out

runners.name: Shifter
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (1m/1m2f); not the force of old but returned from break with respectable runs of late, most recently when a never-nearer third over C&D (good) yesterday; should be in the thick of it if turning out again.
runners.comment: Not the force of old but has been running well, including when 3rd over C&D yesterday

runners.name: Tee Aitch Aye
runners.spotlight: Now 6b lower than when coming from off the pace to open account at Hamilton (1m1f, soft) in September but has been out of form this year (four runs) and needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: Won off 6lb higher in the autumn but has been out of form this year

runners.name: Storm On Jura
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all nine starts; took step in right direction when fourth of six at Musselburgh (1m4f, good) on Tuesday but moves up from 0-55 grade here and needs to build on that recent effort.
runners.comment: 0-9; latest run was a step in the right direction but she needs to improve again

runners.name: Falcon Nine
runners.spotlight: Belatedly came good with two 1m1f wins last summer and looked back in prime form when close second at Pontefract (1m2f, good) last month but his latest run was slightly disappointing and others in the field have more persuasive profiles.
runners.comment: Went close at Pontefract two starts ago but others have more persuasive profiles

races.race_name: Watch Racing TV Free For 31 Days Handicap

runners.name: Eve's Boy
runners.spotlight: Down the weights since some ordinary 7f runs in the middle months of 2025 and looked as if he might take advantage shortly when a close second at Thirsk (1m, good) in April following a break; however, he hasn't run to the same level since and needs a revival returned to 7f.
runners.comment: Good 2nd on return to turf in April (1m); not as good since; has a query on return to 7f

runners.name: Keep Me Stable
runners.spotlight: Won three in a row over 1m and 7f at Musselburgh (all on good) last June and July but she wasn't seen after August and finished down the field on her recent reappearance; dropped just 1lb and likely other days.
runners.comment: Three 7f wins last summer; down the field on reappearance following a layoff; other days

runners.name: Slack Bob
runners.spotlight: Ahead of his mark when a ready winner over 7f on Lingfield AW in May and he had more to do when running with credit behind an improver at Newbury (1m, good to soft) since; this looks his trip for now and much respected for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Ready 7f AW winner in May; creditable 3rd over 1m since; much respected back at 7f
runners.owner: The Old Etonian Racing Syndicate II

runners.name: Whiskey Kisses
runners.spotlight: Maiden who ran some fair races at sprint trips for previous yard but she finished remote over 6f on this track for new yard in June and can only watch over new trip.
runners.comment: Finished remote on yard debut over 6f here and can only watch over new trip

runners.name: Abduction
runners.spotlight: Multiple wins include three over C&D earlier in his career; has run well on occasions since a narrow Musselburgh win (7f, good) in April off this mark and a recent never-nearer third of eight there under Jake Dickson puts him in this picture; yard runs three.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins; won off this mark in April; solid 3rd at Musselburgh latest; bang there

runners.name: Blakefell
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in 7f maiden at Musselburgh (good) in May and he did eventually stick well to the task when third of six back there (1m1f, good) two weeks ago; good chance he has more to come in only his third handicap.
runners.comment: Won 7f maiden in May; creditable 3rd over 1m1f latest; has more to come in handicaps
runners.owner: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow

runners.name: Emery Down
runners.spotlight: Successful in 7f AW maiden in May 2025 for previous yard; has see-sawed in handicaps since but has been back in better form over 1m off a reduced mark of late and the return to 7f should suit; thereabouts.
runners.comment: Won 7f AW maiden in May 2025; mixed since but fair 1m runs of late; return to 7f can suit

runners.name: Ashen
runners.spotlight: Had just two 7f runs on turf for this yard, winning over C&D (good to firm) in May, then third to The Gay Blade here (soft) 17 days ago; weights chance of turning things round with that one but Paul Mulrennan switches to Native Honey; a good run is still on the cards.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May for new yard; solid 3rd since; P Mulrennan switches to Native Honey

runners.name: Native Honey
runners.spotlight: Down the field over 6f and then in a higher grade than this on last two starts but he has more going for him back over C&D, having won his first attempt last August (good) and then quite readily in May (good to firm); solid claims for last year's winning trainer-jockey combination.
runners.comment: Had trip/class excuses of late; made it 2-2 over C&D when winning in May; solid chance

runners.name: Qazaq
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins; 0-9 on turf but has a 7f race in him on grass on best form in the spring and had another troubled run at Beverley on Friday; has worn various aids on last two starts, goes without this time.
runners.comment: Three AW wins; can find a 7f race on turf; various aids worn on last 2 starts, none today

runners.name: Born A Star
runners.spotlight: Usually leads, as when getting off the mark in a 7f Musselburgh maiden last August; had had some disappointments since, though, and he found zero back over that C&D in June; hard to fancy just now.
runners.comment: Usually leads; disappointing since winning 7f maiden as 2yo last August

runners.name: The Gay Blade
runners.spotlight: Has risen to new heights this year, winning six times, the most recent three over 7f on turf (good and soft), but his charmed run ended at Musselburgh last week; runs off the same mark today and has ground to make up on Abduction; may need weight off his back now.
runners.comment: Six wins this year but charmed run of form ended at Musselburgh latest; same mark here

races.race_name: Try Racing TV For Free Now Handicap

runners.name: Starliner
runners.spotlight: Just held on to score over C&D (good to firm) in May and looked unlucky at Hamilton (8.3f, good to firm) two starts ago (persistently denied clear run) but has become rather inconsistent and it's hard to predict whether the first-time cheekpieces will get the best out out him.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May but has become rather inconsistent; tried in cheekpieces today
runners.owner: David Orr & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Ey Up He's A Star
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mainly over 6f/7f but looked suited by step up to 1m when keeping-on third of 18 at Doncaster (good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) three weeks ago; could still have more to offer over this trip; high on the list.
runners.comment: Kept on for third of 18 when upped to 1m at Doncaster three weeks ago; high on the list

runners.name: Hunterian
runners.spotlight: Placed on first two starts this season (7f/8.3f) before opening account over C&D (good to soft) 17 days ago; has scope for further progress and recent 3lb rise does not look excessive; likely contender.
runners.comment: Came good over C&D last month; still quite lightly raced and recent 3lb rise not excessive

runners.name: Filly Eilish
runners.spotlight: Still lightly raced but made low-key handicap/turf debut when sixth of seven at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) a month ago and needs improvement on this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Made low-key handicap/turf debut when sixth of seven over 1m2f last month

runners.name: Hey Havana
runners.spotlight: Clear second at Redcar (7f, good) last month, despite racing too freely in first-time cheekpieces (now removed), and has now performed well on all three starts for new stable this year; still unexposed over 1m; respected.
runners.comment: Three good runs for new stable this season; unexposed over 1m; respected

runners.name: Flying Moonlight
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten all three 2yo starts (6f-7f) but placed behind Hunterian over C&D (soft) when upped in trip for recent seasonal/stable/handicap debut; still unexposed and will be dangerous if that run brought him on.
runners.comment: Placed over C&D on seasonal/handicap debut; dangerous if that run brought him on

runners.name: Penelope's Sister
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner last year, making all on two occasions and ridden prominently on the other; much less effective when ridden very patiently on all four appearances this season but her keeping-on fifth here (1m2f, soft) last month was a big step back in the right direction; well handicapped now and needs close attention in the betting.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins in 2025; not in same form this year but well handicapped now; watch betting

runners.name: Concert Boy
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on pick of this year's AW form but finished well down the field on both starts last month (1m1f/7f) and is now 0-23 on turf.
runners.comment: Five AW wins; well down the field on both starts last month and now 0-23 on turf
runners.owner: Making Headway Racing And K Scott

runners.name: Carmel Valley
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who was seventh of eight behind Hunterian over C&D (soft) on recent stable/handicap debut; may fare better on the forecast faster ground today but is not the most obvious answer.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden; seventh of eight over C&D on recent stable/handicap debut

runners.name: Lightning Galaxy
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; seemingly aided by first-time tongue-tie when respectable fifth of eight at Carlisle (7f, good) three weeks ago and ought to be suited by this return to 1m but others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Ran okay in first-time tongue-tie last month but others have more pressing claims

runners.name: Lovette
runners.spotlight: Yet to make any further progress since winning 1m Ripon maiden a year ago and has been safely held on all three starts this season; might be aided by new tongue-tie and/or cheekpieces, though.
runners.comment: Safely held all three starts this season; might be boosted by new headgear, though

races.race_name: Ladbrokes Get More With Racing Bet Builder Ayr Silver Cup Trial Handicap

runners.name: Manila Scouse
runners.spotlight: Close up on consecutive outings in May (5f/6f) and also ran well when sixth of 21 at York (6f, good; behind Woven) last month; still on a workable mark and ought to be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Placed twice in May and his sixth of 21 at York last month was another good effort

runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: Placed twice off higher marks on Tapeta (6f/5f) at start of this year and may not have been suited by the soft ground when safely held over C&D last month, after a break; others appeal more all the same, though.
runners.comment: Had possible ground excuse for last month's low-key turf return but others appeal more

runners.name: Jordan Electrics
runners.spotlight: Regressive 10yo who has not won since 2024; ran well on consecutive 7f starts in April/May and is well handicapped on those efforts but recent sprint form has been below par.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on spring 7f form but recent sprint runs have been below par
runners.owner: B Jordan, Brian Jordan, S Jordan & N McConnell

runners.name: Daizen
runners.spotlight: Returned to form at Thirsk (6f, good) last month, making all to win quite cosily, and is now 2-12; 5lb higher in a higher-grade race today but his other win was gained over C&D and he won't mind if there's rain about.
runners.comment: Made all to win quite cosily at Thirsk last month; up in grade here but still shortlisted

runners.name: Kelpie Grey
runners.spotlight: Gained all four wins over 7f+ and is yet to hit top gear this season but attracted stewards' attention when keeping on for sixth under tender handling over C&D (soft) last month and remains well handicapped; one to keep a close eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: Attracted stewards' attention when sixth over C&D under tender handling last month

runners.name: Woven
runners.spotlight: Veteran who still retains most of his ability and gave a good account when keeping-on second of 21 at York (6f, good) last month; still only 1lb higher than for C&D (heavy) win in October and will be favoured by any rain.
runners.comment: Kept on well for second of 21 at York last month and will be favoured by any rain
runners.owner: John Sagar And Dunham Trading Ltd

runners.name: Territorial Knight
runners.spotlight: Fifth over C&D (soft) in Bronze Cup in September and filled same position in 19-runner Doncaster handicap (6f, good to soft) on reappearance in March; slightly disappointing on good to firm ground last time but conditions ought to be suitable for him today; one to consider.
runners.comment: Ran well on seasonal debut and had possible ground excuse last time; one to consider

runners.name: Tip Foster
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who delivered on debut promise when game winner of 7f Thirsk maiden (good) last month, despite racing too freely; faces tougher task on this handicap debut but has plenty of scope for further progress and, in the short-term at least, this drop back to 6f could be the right move.
runners.comment: Game winner of 7f Thirsk maiden last month and remains unexposed after only two runs

runners.name: Here Forever
runners.spotlight: Readily won modest four-runner Ripon maiden (6f, good) for George Boughey in September but was unable to land a telling blow in two 5f handicaps for new stable this season; remains lightly raced and ought to be suited by this move back up in trip but others have less to prove.
runners.comment: Low-mileage 3yo; unable to land a telling blow in two 5f handicaps this season

runners.name: Cotai Lights
runners.spotlight: Seemed to respond well to first-time cheekpieces when fourth at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in May but ran poorly when dropped back to 6f later that month and now goes without headgear; others look safer.
runners.comment: Fourth in first-time cheekpieces two runs ago (7f); well held since (6f); no headgear here

runners.name: Parisiac
runners.spotlight: Made all over 5f on seasonal debut and finished second on both starts since, latterly under Cara Tuke in 14-runner C&D (soft) contest 16 days ago; evidently in good nick; ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice since 5f win on seasonal debut, latterly over C&D last month; respected

runners.name: Lord Bertie
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when midfield at York (7f, good) last month, having been dropped in from stall 20 of 20, and is back on a good mark now; not ruled out, particularly if there's significant rain about.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly over 7f last time and significant rain will heighten interest

runners.name: Rousing Encore
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner; finished well for fourth at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in May but has rather mixed record since returned to turf in April and never really got involved at York last time.
runners.comment: Has rather mixed record since returned to turf and never really got involved last time

runners.name: Gweedore
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a 7f win on soft ground but made a slow start to this campaign; not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Ended last season with 7f win on soft ground but has made slow start to this campaign

runners.name: The Caltonian
runners.spotlight: Belied 100-1 odds when respectable fifth of 14 off his much higher AW mark at Newcastle (6f) last week but has 0-20 strike-rate on turf; others have more persuasive profiles.
runners.comment: Ran well off his much higher AW mark last week but has 0-20 strike-rate on turf
runners.owner: John Murphy & Miss L A Perratt

runners.name: Misunderstood
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who is yet to add to his 2yo Group 3 win; safely held on all three British starts this year but positives can be drawn from his keeping-on sixth at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last month and he might be seen to better effect if the ground is on the slow side of good here.
runners.comment: Safely held on all three British starts but positives can be drawn from latest run

runners.name: Prince Of Pillo
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent during the AW season and made nothing better than a satisfactory reappearance when midfield over C&D (soft) last month; on another career-low mark today but needs that recent run to have brought him on.
runners.comment: On another career-low mark but needs recent reappearance run to have brought him on

runners.name: Dakota Gold
runners.spotlight: Smart in his prime and a multiple winner over the years but became disappointing after last season's winning reappearance and was last of 20 when back in action at York in May; needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Veteran who finished last on his seasonal debut; needs to turn things around

races.race_name: 25% Off Lunch At Western House Hotel Handicap

runners.name: Keep The Gold
runners.spotlight: Not yet off the mark and he's raced only at 5f since handicapping but he did look worth another go at 6f when keeping on well in fourth here (soft) last month, when first-time blinkers replaced cheekpieces; thereabouts.
runners.comment: Maiden; all handicaps at 5f but looked worth another go at 6f when close up here latest

runners.name: White Ladder
runners.spotlight: Has led; 0-9 but he only just failed to hang on in an AW handicap (6f) on final 2yo start and he's run two good races over 7f (good and soft) for new connections this year; very likely to go well back over 6f.
runners.comment: 0-9 but narrowly beaten over 6f on final 2yo start; two good 7f runs for new yard in 2026

runners.name: Ellie's de Vega
runners.spotlight: Can lead; came to the end of his tether over 7f on soft ground here recently and he's more favourably treated now than when close up over 6f at Hamilton (good) in May; does need a bit more for a first win, though.
runners.comment: Outstayed over 7f on soft latest; slight slip in weights since close 3rd over 6f in May

runners.name: Maynora
runners.spotlight: Has remained in form since breaking his duck at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) in April, albeit he didn't find much back at 7f on Newcastle AW recently; likely to give his running but others may have more scope off their current marks.
runners.comment: Remained in form since 6f win in April; others may have more scope off their current marks

runners.name: April Diamond
runners.spotlight: Belated debut in April; slowly away in three of just four starts, including on handicap debut at Carlisle (6f, good), but there was definite promise in her second of eight there; capable of better off the same mark.
runners.comment: Belated debut in April; improved form when 2nd on handicap debut (6f) latest; improve

runners.name: Henery Hawk
runners.spotlight: All seven AW wins at 5f but was never involved on Newcastle Tapeta ten days ago; 0-21 on turf and something new is needed back at 6f on grass.
runners.comment: All seven wins at 5f on AW; 0-21 on turf; big query about return to 6f on grass

runners.name: Saxon Gem
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who couldn't get going quickly enough on handicap debut over 6f at Carlisle but was struggling from a fair way out when upped to 1m at Musselburgh in June; others more likely for the win.
runners.comment: Outpaced over 6f at Carlisle on handicap debut; beaten a long way when upped to 1m since

runners.name: Saxon Grace
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has finished close up in two of three 6f handicaps for new yard, notably when finding Carlisle's stiff test at the trip a bit much for her in May; lesser efforts at 5f and 6f since, though, the fitting of cheekpieces at Catterick last time not an obvious pointer for this.
runners.comment: Maiden; close up in two of three 6f handicaps this year; not at best on last two starts

runners.name: Baby Rover
runners.spotlight: A good spell in 2025 included a Redcar win (6f, good to firm) and a close second in this race (good to soft); slow to find her form this year but things started to look up when she was second of nine at Carlisle (6f) in June; primed to go well.
runners.comment: Good spell in 2025 included a 6f win and close 2nd in this race; better latest; solid
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Newyorkstateofmind
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike-rate on the AW and he's won just once on turf in the last three years; however, he only just lost out over 5f at Catterick (good) in May and has a decent run in him if on song.
runners.comment: Just one turf win in the last 3 years; close 2nd over 5f in May; chance if on song

runners.name: Royal Duke
runners.spotlight: All three wins at 5f on good ground; not quite nailing it this year and it's up in the air as to whether this is his trip, having been well held in sole previous attempt, over C&D in April 2025.
runners.comment: All three wins at 5f; well treated but well held in sole 6f run, over C&D in April 2025

runners.name: Joshuas Dream
runners.spotlight: One useful 5f run as 2yo; well held in two handicaps last autumn following an absence but has dropped 7lb for those defeats and remains one to be interested in for yard that's won this three times (including two divisions) since 2021, all for Paul Mulrennan; market can guide.
runners.comment: Useful 5f form as 2yo; well beaten in two handicaps last autumn; may do a lot better here

runners.name: So Grateful
runners.spotlight: Has course form at 5f; losing run goes back to Thirsk (6f, good to firm) in May 2025 and he's been through troubled times since, despite taking a healthy slide down the weights; risky.
runners.comment: Sliding down weights but out of sorts since latest win, at Thirsk (6f) in May 2025

races.race_name: Dream Weddings At Western House Hotel Handicap

runners.name: La Tosca
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in all three handicaps; it's questionable what she achieved when beaten 16l in three-runner contest at Doncaster (1m6f, good to firm) last time but she still features prominently in calculations here.
runners.comment: Runner-up in all three handicaps, albeit beaten 16l in three-runner race last time
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Aighear
runners.spotlight: Won twice on slow ground here in the autumn (1m7f/1m5f) but was behind La Tosca and Ebony Maw when keeping-on fourth here (1m7f, soft) last month and the forecast quicker ground today is not ideal.
runners.comment: Dual course winner on slow ground in the autumn but behind two of these last month

runners.name: Is She Now
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a low-grade Irish handicap hurdle in May but 2-2 for new stable since returning to the Flat last month, the wins gained over C&D (soft) and at Musselburgh (1m4f, good); probably still on a good mark under 4lb penalty for latter success, and commands respect in current mood.
runners.comment: 2-2 for new stable last month and probably still well handicapped under 4lb penalty

runners.name: Ebony Maw
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner; on a losing run of 17 but was seemingly perked up by refitted cheekpieces when third here (1m7f, soft; just behind La Tosca) last month and competes off another career-low mark today.
runners.comment: Perked up by refitted cheekpieces when third here (1m7f) last time; career-low mark today

runners.name: Elemental Eye
runners.spotlight: Seemed to benefit from combination of drop back in trip and change of headgear when clearcut winner at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW; first-time blinkers) nine days ago; 6lb higher here and too inconsistent to rely upon heavily but the return to turf won't be a problem.
runners.comment: Clear AW winner in first-time blinkers last week; too inconsistent to rely upon heavily

runners.name: This Rib
runners.spotlight: Ran as though something was amiss on seasonal/handicap debut in May (7f) and finished well down the field at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) last month; hiked up in trip here; big leap of faith required to support him.
runners.comment: Began handicap career with two very disappointing runs; hiked up in trip here

runners.name: Galahad Threepwood
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form but hasn't won on the Flat since 2021 and, following a 406-day absence, he finished last in recent 1m3f Hamilton race won by Annandale; has too much to prove.
runners.comment: Finished last at Hamilton last month, after a layoff, and has too much to prove

runners.name: Idyllic
runners.spotlight: Made satisfactory seasonal debut in April and although easily reeled in after building up big lead at Doncaster in June, she ran encouragingly here (1m2f, good) yesterday, keeping on steadily into fourth; has won over 1m4f and capable of going well over this slightly longer trip.
runners.comment: Has won at 1m4f; never-nearer 4th over 1m2f here yesterday; capable of going well

runners.name: Annandale
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his nine wins over this C&D; disappointing favourite when well-held third of six at Hamilton (1m5f, good to firm) 11 days ago but won over 1m3f there a week earlier and has claims if judged on that form.
runners.comment: Well held when third at Hamilton recently but won there two starts ago

races.race_name: Knockcroghery Claiming Hurdle

runners.name: Rocky's Howya
runners.spotlight: Has been making hay in claiming hurdles this year and has won four of his last six starts; dropped back in trip to 2m4f to complete a trio of claimers at Clonmel on penultimate (good to yielding); found to be blowing hard post-race and had a graze when tailed off over fences here last time; of obvious interest back in claimer company, although best form is on softer.
runners.comment: Won last four of five hurdle starts; had excuses when tailed off over fences last time

runners.name: Garnetot
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; best of nine hurdle runs came when runner-up in a Clonmel maiden over 2m4f last autumn on good ground; beaten when fell next time and has been tailed off in two runs this season; doesn't come out the best at the weights and hasn't run anywhere near his rating recently.
runners.comment: Doesn't come out the best at the weights and hasn't run anywhere near rating recently

runners.name: Howdoyalikeherhome
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; won a novice handicap hurdle at Down Royal in April last year and posted some good placed efforts subsequently; form tailed off in August and his two chase runs this year leave a lot to be desired; best treated at these weights but must return to somewhere near his best after just a six day break since his last run.
runners.comment: Best treated at these weights but chase runs this year were poor; needs his best

runners.name: Tullyveery Lad
runners.spotlight: 5-39 under rules; three of those have come in chases, the latest last August at Tramore (2m6f, good); moderate efforts in that sphere in his opening two runs this year and even worse back over hurdles at Ballinrobe, although badly hampered at the second; has O'Keeffe aboard now; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Five-time winner has been poor this year but a better effort here is not ruled out
runners.owner: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody

runners.name: Bocelli's Voice
runners.spotlight: Weak chase form over the past 12 months and holds a modest hurdles rating; beaten 15l in a Sligo claimer last time (2m2f, good); veteran faces a stiff task once again.
runners.comment: Modest hurdles rating and beaten 15l in a claimer last time; faces stiff task again

runners.name: Paul Collins
runners.spotlight: Won a Galway novice handicap in October (2m7f, yielding); but out of form since; has youth on his side but form is off-putting and carries 6lb more than Howdoyalikeherhome but would receive 9lb from that rival in a handicap.
runners.comment: Galway h'cap winner in Oct' but out of form since and not well treated by weights

runners.name: Live My Dream
runners.spotlight: Not much to shout about in two point-to-point runs and moderate efforts under rules as well, including in opening two handicap runs; makes stable debut in first-time cheekpieces but work to do at these weights.
runners.comment: Not much to shout about in form to date inc' two points; work to do at these weights

runners.name: Getaway Charlie
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run since winning a Punchestown handicap in 2023; heavy defeats in two hurdle runs this year; others preferred.
runners.comment: On a long losing run and took heavy defeats in two runs this year; others preferred

races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Frankie's Freebie
runners.spotlight: Point winner has run some solid races in defeat in maiden hurdles behind decent sorts; handled good ground when second after a break at Punchestown last time; a big player.
runners.comment: Handled good ground when second after a break at Punchestown last time; a big player

runners.name: Killowen House
runners.spotlight: Point winner in April ran a cracker on hurdles debut when third in a 3m Cork maiden hurdle; surprising move to go back to 2m1f at Sligo since but caught they eye staying on; this trip is more suitable and a chance.
runners.comment: Third in a 3m Cork maiden hurdle; stayed on over 2m1f at Sligo; chance over this trip

runners.name: Take The Free
runners.spotlight: Poor on debut at Cork but was much better there next time and improved again when runner-up over 2m at this track since; this step up in trip looks as if it will suit and looks a major contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 2m here last time; step up in trip looks as if it will suit; big player

runners.name: Lilac Lady
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; Flat maiden has run well at times over hurdles, mostly at Sligo; tongue-tie is added and needs to find more to score.
runners.comment: Has run well at times over hurdles, mostly at Sligo; needs to find more to score

runners.name: Fuusland
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam bumper and 2m3f/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful winners Mount Pelier (bumper/2m2f chase/2m3f hurdle) and Legends Gold (2m-3m hurdle/chase); cost E5,000 as a foal; worth a market check coming from a top yard.
runners.comment: Cost E5,000 as a foal; worth a market check coming from a top yard

runners.name: Cooladdi
runners.spotlight: Third in a Clonmel bumper last year before an 11l runner-up in this race; not as good in three starts since and has to find improvement on his best.
runners.comment: An 11l runner-up in this race last year; not as good since and has to find improvement

runners.name: Online Order
runners.spotlight: Raced keenly when beaten 43l in a Limerick bumper on debut and can only be watched with hood retained.
runners.comment: Raced keenly when beaten 43l in a Limerick bumper on debut and can only be watched

runners.name: Sea Feliz
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Morricone; dam bumper winner, half-sister to useful bumper and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Encore Champs; cost E19,000 as a 3yo; debutante has to be taken seriously from this source, more so if strong in the market.
runners.comment: Debutante has to be taken seriously from this source, more so if strong in the market

runners.name: Go To The Moon
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000GBP after winning a point in 2025; off for over a year before finishing tailed-off in a Sligo bumper; has to leave that run well behind.
runners.comment: Tailed-off in a Sligo bumper on return; has to leave that run well behind
runners.owner: A Cahill, M Dowd, P Glancy Partnership

runners.name: Imarajan
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden ran his best race over hurdles when runner-up in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time; the same headgear combination worn then retained; can be involved again.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time and can be involved again

runners.name: Casper Charlie
runners.spotlight: Beaten 42l in a Punchestown bumper on debut and can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: Beaten 42l in a Punchestown bumper on debut and can only be watched for now

runners.name: Little Big John
runners.spotlight: Put up his best effort at Punchestown last time with a hood and tongue-tie added; the tongue-tie is left off and could get involved with further progress.
runners.comment: Best effort at Punchestown last time and could get involved with further progress

runners.name: Blue Nude
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off in a Punchestown bumper on debut and can only be watched today.
runners.comment: Tailed-off in a Punchestown bumper on debut and can only be watched today

runners.name: Midnight Musical
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability in points, bumpers and maiden hurdles without winning; well beaten at Wexford three days ago and has to do much better.
runners.comment: Was well beaten at Wexford three days ago and has to do much better

runners.name: Acheron
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden improved hugely on previous form when runner-up in a Downpatrick 2m6f maiden hurdle; needs to show that wasn't a fluke but can be involved again if repeating that.
runners.comment: Big-priced runner-up in a Downpatrick 2m6f maiden hurdle; involved again if repeating that

races.race_name: Shanagher Hearing Maiden Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Luker's Tipple
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden has run well in defeat lots of times over hurdles (13 starts) including at Limerick last time; ground-versatile and has the highest published rating in the field so should be bang there again.
runners.comment: Placed lots of times over hurdles including at Limerick last time; be bang there again

runners.name: Astelia
runners.spotlight: Has been runner-up in six of her eight hurdle starts but there was no improvement tackling a first handicap at Ballinrobe last time; needs to find a bit extra to get the job done.
runners.comment: Runner-up in six of her eight hurdle starts; needs to find a bit extra to get the job done

runners.name: Firebrand
runners.spotlight: His sole Flat win came at this track in 2024 and is now rated 71 in that sphere; lots of good efforts in 10 maiden hurdle runs including on comeback at Punchestown last time; penalised 8lb makes it difficult for him but should run well.
runners.comment: Solid at Punchestown last time; 8lb penalty makes it difficult for him but should run well

runners.name: Game Point
runners.spotlight: Useful but frustrating Flat maiden for Ger Lyons; solid efforts in maiden hurdles at Sligo and Limerick; was ahead of Luker's Tipple on latter occasion and should confirm that form on 2lb worse terms.
runners.comment: Ahead of Luker's Tipple last time and should confirm that form on 2lb worse terms

runners.name: Cocofred
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle on heavy ground but much better on good at Tramore last time; can be a player with further progress likely.
runners.comment: Better on good ground at Tramore last time; can be a player with further progress likely

runners.name: Pretty Wild
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Marshalled (useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase), Hands On (2m hurdle) and Teenage Kiss (3m hurdle); dam maiden hurdler, half-sister to useful 2m hurdle winner Miss Pronunciation; nicely-bred and Harry Cobden takes the mount; watch for market strength.
runners.comment: Nicely-bred and Harry Cobden takes the mount; watch for market strength

runners.name: Poetic Parable
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam point/3m hurdle winner, out of unraced half-sister to 2m2f hurdle winner Long Walk Home (dam of smart 2m1f-3m hurdle/chase winner Rocky's Diamond); by a promising young sire and a decent damline so could run well on debut.
runners.comment: By a promising young sire and a decent damline so could run well on debut

runners.name: Lengaruka
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to four winners inc Norathir (Listed-placed French 9.7f AW/11.7f Flat, RPR 95; 2m2f hurdle) and Louvetot (French 1m2f AW Flat/2m1f hurdle); dam Listed-placed French 1m3f/1m4f winner; nicely-bred sort cost £55,000 as a 2yo; could go well on debut.
runners.comment: Nicely-bred sort cost £55,000 as a 2yo; could go well on debut

runners.name: Tellyouwhat
runners.spotlight: Started at 200/1 and pulled-up in a Limerick maiden hurdle on debut; can't be fancied.
runners.comment: Started at 200/1 and pulled-up in a Limerick maiden hurdle on debut; can't be fancied

runners.name: Finjimk
runners.spotlight: Fell and pulled-up in points; beaten 21l in a Hexham bumper since; one to watch for now.
runners.comment: Fell and pulled-up in points; beaten 21l in a Hexham bumper since; one to watch for now

runners.name: How's Ellie
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in a Galway bumper on debut last October but was well below that level on soft at Tramore next time; has to do more on return/hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Good bumper debut but below that next time; has to do more on return/hurdling debut

runners.name: Ozark's Walk
runners.spotlight: Finished in the frame in three bumpers but has been well beaten in three maiden hurdles and can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: Has been well beaten in three maiden hurdles and can only be watched for now

runners.name: Sunny Dude
runners.spotlight: Regressive Flat maiden was well beaten on hurdling debut and can't be fancied.
runners.comment: Regressive Flat maiden was well beaten on hurdling debut and can't be fancied

runners.name: Dadou Part Two
runners.spotlight: Beaten 28l in a Cork bumper on debut and will have to do much better with a hood added.
runners.comment: Beaten 28l in a Cork bumper on debut and will have to do much better with a hood added

runners.name: Glengarriff
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in both maiden hurdle starts and can't be fancied.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in both maiden burdle starts and can't be fancied

races.race_name: Shanagher Hearing Maiden Hurdle (Div II)
SuperValu Co. Roscommon Ladies Day Novice Hurdle

runners.name: Dani Donadoni
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m3f Limerick maiden hurdle and unseated at the first in a Punchestown handicap next time; didn't jump that well and idled badly when just denied in a 3m Wexford novice last time; down massively in trip; highest-rated here but far from bomb-proof.
runners.comment: Won a 2m3f Limerick maiden hurdle and just denied in a 3m Wexford novice; down in trip

runners.name: Lizzie Twigg
runners.spotlight: Down Royal debut bumper winner didn't build on that in Listed company next time; however, bounced back to win nicely on hurdles debut at Punchestown; this is tougher and she needs more but could find it so is considered.
runners.comment: Bumper winner won nicely on hurdles debut at Punchestown; needs more but considered

runners.name: The Store Boy
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form to win a Ballinrobe maiden hurdle last time with the minimum of fuss; needs to find more again but is going the right way and has to be considered.
runners.comment: Improved to win a Ballinrobe maiden h'dle last time; needs to find more again

runners.name: Endless Talking
runners.spotlight: Improved form lately in easily winning Downpatrick maiden hurdle before adding a Tramore beginners' chase; has a bit to find on ratings with Dani Donadoni but is bang in form and can go well.
runners.comment: Easy D'patrick maiden hurdle winner added a chase win since; a bit to find but can go well

runners.name: Whoyougonnacall
runners.spotlight: Was poor in a bumper last year at Ballinrobe but was running well in a maiden hurdle at Clonmel on return when a bit unlucky to fall; this is a step up in class but he could give a good account.
runners.comment: Poor in a bumper last year but was running well in a maiden hurdle when falling on return

runners.name: Move It On Over
runners.spotlight: Maiden over hurdles is rated only 74 so is out of his depth in this company; blinkers added.
runners.comment: Maiden over hurdles is rated only 74 so out of his depth

runners.name: Suresuresure
runners.spotlight: Just a hint of promise in five bumpers; however, it wasn't a bad hurdling debut at Listowel but this demands a lot more.
runners.comment: Not a bad hurdling debut at Listowel but this demands a lot more

races.race_name: Sheehy Meares/Team Earley Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Dontdooddson
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Annie's Angel
runners.owner: Conor O'Connor & Colum Currie & Mark Devenny

races.race_name: Roscommon Herald Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Something Simple
runners.owner: Something Simple Syndicate/J C Hurley Et Al

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Goodgollymissholly
runners.spotlight: Pulled up at 100-1 on debut last June but left that form well behind when debuting for top yard at Downpatrick a year later, a clear runner-up of eight (2m2f, good, 11-1); her RPR of 108 that day is the best on show in this field but must back it up.
runners.comment: Clear runner-up on stable debut last month; 108 RPR that day is best on show here

runners.name: Gratitudeforgrace
runners.spotlight: Unsold for 10,000euros as 2yo; dam French 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to useful French 2m1f-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Dentor Des Obeaux; market can split trainers' two.
runners.comment: Dam French 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner; market can split trainers' two

runners.name: Carleys Lilly
runners.spotlight: First reserve; made an eye-catching debut effort when a never-nearer fourth of 18 at Clonmel in a maiden hurdle (2m1f, good to yielding) in May but was disappointing at Limerick later that month over 2m4f.
runners.comment: Reserve; never nearer fourth on m'den hurdle debut (66-1) but disappointing next time

runners.name: Red Sea Girl
runners.spotlight: Built on a moderate hurdling debut at Wexford in August with a much improved display back there later that month when a 5.5l third (2m1f, good); went one place better in a Tipperary bumper when last seen in October (2m, good to yielding); in the mix on form but may improve for this return.
runners.comment: Third on second hurdles start and went one place better in a bumper in Oct'; in the mix

runners.name: Any News For Me
runners.spotlight: Wasn't beaten out the gate in winter bumpers at Leopardstown and Navan and there were again positives to take from her fifth of ten back from a break at Punchestown last time (2m1f, good to yielding).
runners.comment: Not beaten out the gate in two winter bumpers and positives in her return from a break too

runners.name: Back In Favour
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Win Some Lose Some (useful 2m3f-2m7f hurdle) and Don'tstopbelievin (point); made the breakthrough at the sixth attempt in points in May for Derek O'Connor; hooded for rules bow; improvement needed
runners.comment: Won at the sixth attempt in points last time; improvement needed on rules bow

runners.name: Fournonblondes
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase winner Stringtoyourbow; dam point winner, half-sister to 2m5f chase/3m hurdle winner Winchester Red, out of prolific 2m hurdle/chase winning half-sister to Grand National winner Red Marauder; trainer 1-76 in bumpers last five seasons.
runners.comment: Half-sister to hurdle/chase winner Stringtoyourbow; trained 1-76 in bumpers last 5 seasons

runners.name: Madame Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Dam runner-up in AW bumper, sister to bumper and 2m3f/2m5f hurdle winner Aggy With It, half-sister to 2m3f-2m7f hurdle winner Thanksforthehelp, out of maiden half-sister to high-class hurdlers Agrapart (up to 3m2f) and Afsoun (2m); watching brief advised.
runners.comment: Dam runner-up in AW bumper; watching brief advised

runners.name: Nancy Wheeler
runners.spotlight: 10,000euros foal; half-sister to 2m7f hurdle/3m chase winner General Hubble; dam bumper winner, sister to useful bumper and 2m4f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Aimigayle and useful 2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase winner Emmaslegend; this will be just the fifth ride under rules for today's jockey.
runners.comment: Dam won a bumper; just fifth ride under rules for today's jockey

runners.name: Shuil Solas
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to six winners inc Gallant John Joe (useful 2m-2m6f hurdle), Space Cadet (useful bumper and 2m/3m4f chase), Jot'Em Down (bumper and 3m/3m2f chase) and Farrants Way (3m1f hurdle); dam bumper/2m3f hurdle winner; good lady rider booked; check market.
runners.comment: Half-sister to six winners; good lady rider booked; check market

runners.name: The Cormick Chick
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to winners Mr Vango (Midlands Grand National), Ros Brin (2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and Cheap As Chips (2m hurdle/chase); trainer 0-11 in bumpers last five seasons; best watched.
runners.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to three winners inc' Midlands National winner Mr Vango; watch

runners.name: Eleen Alana
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; half-sister to winners Thou Art Peter (1m/1m2f inc HK dirt; RPR 80) and Bungle Inthedesert (1m AW; 73); dam unraced half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Saab Alamanal, out of half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Racer Forever; trainer 0-18 in bumpers last five seasons.
runners.comment: Reserve; half-sister to two Flat winners; trainer 0-18 in bumpers last five seasons

runners.name: Likeyouhaveplenty
runners.spotlight: Jumped poorly when pulled up on debut at Tramore (2m, soft) and tailed off at Punchestown last month; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: PU and tailed off in opening runs over hurdles; hard to fancy

runners.name: Ronnie's Rascal
