runners.spotlight: Yeats filly kept on to take third in the dying strides of a Cork academy hurdle (2m2f, good); perhaps unsuited by softer conditions back there next time when tailed off; big player here with top rider aboard.
runners.comment: Third on hurdles bow but below that on softer next time; big player with top rider aboard

runners.name: Flowers In Therain
runners.spotlight: Sister to bumper winner Kilbarry Leader; dam bumper/2m6f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful winners Tailors Hall (2m4f/2m7f hurdle) and The Westener Boy (bumper/3m chase); makes belated debut at age of seven.
runners.comment: Dan won a bumper as did her full sister; makes belated debut as a 7yo

runners.name: Aodha's Arrow
runners.spotlight: Form of debut effort at Cork last year (good) has received a couple of boosts but she didn't build on it when beaten 14.5l back there next time (good); capable of better and too soon to write off.
runners.comment: Fourth on debut and form has worked out; didn't build on that next time; capable of more

runners.name: Bayswater Bloom
runners.spotlight: Dropped away on debut at Listowel at 150-1 last September; got closer at Punchestown the following month when fifth of ten; others preferred.
runners.comment: Moderate efforts in two bumpers last year; others preferred

runners.name: My Girl Rosie
runners.spotlight: Beaten 38l on debut at Cork (2m1f, good, 7-1); much more needed but SP that day suggests there could be.
runners.comment: Beaten 38l on debut; much more needed but 7-1 SP that day suggests there could be

runners.name: Sheactslikesummer
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; tailed off on debut at Newbury (good to soft, 20-1) in a rare British runner for this yard; hood goes on now.
runners.comment: Reserve; tailed off on debut at Newbury; hood goes on now

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D)(GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Eleven Eighty Two
runners.spotlight: Twice-raced filly; kept on well for close second, despite still seeming green, at Carlisle (6f, good) last time; the form pick and looks open to further progress to boot.
runners.comment: Close second at Carlisle last time; the form pick and looks open to further progress

runners.name: Halcon
runners.spotlight: Belied her market position (rank outsider) in C&D maiden on good ground, finishing 2l third of seven; one of the main players, provided she backs up that effort.
runners.comment: Finished third of seven in C&D maiden; one of the main form contenders

runners.name: Lady Rosalind
runners.spotlight: Represents major stable; started second favourite in Yarmouth maiden (6f) but ended up running as if the outing/experience was needed; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Major stable; seemed to need the outing in Yarmouth maiden; open to improvement

runners.name: Travellers Girl
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in a couple of 6f contests, finishing fourth at Ripon then third at Thirsk; latter effort was five days ago; again has frame possibilities.
runners.comment: Finished fourth at Ripon then third at Thirsk; again has frame possibilities

runners.name: Turbo Shandy
runners.spotlight: Both starts in 7f sellers, better effort when rallying fourth of five at Musselburgh latest; doesn't appear to be crying out for this drop in distance.
runners.comment: Both starts in 7f sellers; doesn't appear to be crying out for 6f

runners.name: Texting
runners.spotlight: 32,000gns yearling; Caturra half-sister to two winners, notably Clearpoint (Listed-placed 5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 105); stable is 0-14 with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: 32,000gns yearling; by Caturra; stable is 0-14 with 2yos this season

runners.name: Spirit Of Lyra
runners.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; by Lucky Vega; closely related to Hungarian 1m winner Almos Vezer, out of well-related 6f 2yo winner (RPR 83); stable is 3-4 with 2yos on turf this term; respected debutante.
runners.comment: 16,000gns yearling; stable is 3-4 with 2yos on turf this term; respected debutante

runners.name: Sovereign Grace
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability, without landing a blow, in 5f event at York where she finished sixth of nine; may do better over this extra furlong with the experience under her belt.
runners.comment: May do better upped to 6f with York effort under her belt

runners.name: Sweet Iris
runners.spotlight: £25,000 yearling; by Blackbeard; dam unraced half-sister to 6f/7f Group 3 winner Majestic Queen, out of 1m2f winner; one of two newcomers for her yard; market instructive.
runners.comment: £25,000 yearling; one of two newcomers for her yard; market instructive

runners.name: Thunder Filly
runners.spotlight: 25,000gns foal, 24,000euros yearling; Lope Y Fernandez half-sister to two winners, notably Heavenly Holly (Listed-placed 7f AW; RPR 98); yard also runs Sweet Iris; check the betting.
runners.comment: 24,000euros yearling; yard also runs Sweet Iris; check the betting

runners.name: Spark In The Coal
runners.spotlight: Has achieved little in a couple of 5f races (maiden/claimer) at Beverley.
runners.comment: Poor claims on her Beverley efforts

runners.name: Celita Star
runners.spotlight: Only sixth of seven over the minimum trip at Hamilton but ran on in the final furlong and may fare better in this 6f race.
runners.comment: May fare better upped to 6f with Hamilton effort under her belt

runners.name: Wells Fargo Stage
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for modest fifth over 7f at Carlisle last time; drop back to 6f is far from certain to prompt the necessary further progress.
runners.comment: Modest fifth over 7f last time; needs further progress

races.race_name: Merit Estates Chartered Surveyors Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Alterity
runners.spotlight: Front-running, thrice-raced filly whose RPRs are moving in the right direction; good third at Beverley (8.5f, good) most recently; the pick on form and should have her own way at a track that is likely to suit.
runners.comment: Front-running, thrice-raced filly who is the form pick and should have her own way

runners.name: Queen's Hame
runners.spotlight: Filly by Gleneagles; sibling to five winners, notably Hoodwinker (1m-1m2f; 92); dam unraced half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Pongee; represents major yard and starts off in an uncompetitive race; interesting.
runners.comment: Sibling to five winners; represents major yard and starts off in an uncompetitive race

runners.name: War And Love
runners.spotlight: Form dipped sharply on final AW start early last year for Sir Mark Prescott; seemed to need the outing when a 33-1 shot on stable/seasonal debut; the market signals may again provide guidance.
